title: Installing Libraries: Supercharging Code
summary: Understand open-source modular libraries and how to install them with the Library Manager.

steps.title: What is a Library?
steps.markdownContent: A library is a pre-written bundle of code created by engineers so you don't have to reinvent the wheel. Just `#include <LibraryName.h>`!

steps.title: Using the Library Manager
steps.markdownContent: Open **Tools > Manage Libraries...** in the Arduino IDE. Search for libraries like `LiquidCrystal_I2C` and click Install.

interactiveConfig.question: What is the primary benefit of libraries?
options: They speed up code by writing complex hardware protocols for you
They replace the need for physical wires
